text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The members of Team First began practicing 
independently behind Acting Director 
Kashimoto's back, but they were found out 
and scolded.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Acting Director Kashimoto is overly 
strict, but she undeniably cares deeply 
for her members. Asking Chairwoman Akikawa 
about the reason for her strictness...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Acting Director Kashimoto was once an 
exceptional Trainer who respected freedom. 
However, her trainee broke down from 
overwork during voluntary training and was 
forced to retire...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since, she came to firmly believe 
that strict and thorough management was 
essential to protecting Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the Aoharu Cup served as a 
rehabilitation program for her as well.
